event_name: Date 04 July 2021 Time 16:22 2021 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 01 - 04 July 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Forcing another driver off the track.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2 of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, At the entry of turn 6, LEC and PER were side by side. Then on the exit PER was judged not to give LEC enough room and LEC was forced off the track.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 11 Forcing Another Driver Off The Track T6
